title: ERP paradigm of the Mobile BCI dataset
description: This dataset comprises EEG recordings from 24 healthy participants performing a P300-based brain-computer interface task during various locomotion states (standing, walking, running). The study utilized 73 EEG channels plus 4 EOG auxiliary channels with visual oddball stimulation to investigate event-related potentials in mobile BCI applications. EOG was recorded on 4 auxiliary channels to monitor eye movements, providing a benchmark resource for evaluating BCI performance across different motor states.
methods_description: EEG data were acquired at 100 Hz sampling rate using a 73-channel BrainAmp system (Brain Product GmbH) with Ag/AgCl electrodes referenced to FCz and grounded at Fpz. Four additional EOG auxiliary channels were recorded to monitor eye movements. Participants performed a visual oddball P300 task across 5 sessions. The experimental protocol involved target and non-target visual stimuli presented during different locomotion conditions (standing, walking, running).
